My contribution

A practical role across the production.

I joined Murder in the Valleys for lighting and went on to work as a second camera operator. That included car-rig material and pickups, alongside the lighting work needed to build scenes on location.

I also photographed the official production stills. The images here are still photographs I made for the series; they are distinct from my camera work in the finished episodes.
